p11-01.title: Physical Quantities and Vectors
p11-01.concepts: Vectors possess both magnitude and direction and obey vector laws of addition. Key NEB focus: Resolution of vectors into rectangular components (Rx = R cosθ, Ry = R sinθ), triangle law, and parallelogram law of vector addition.
p11-01.bilingual: Vector भन्नाले magnitude र direction दुवै भएको भौतिक राशि हो। Parallelogram law अनुसार यदि दुई vector लाई parallelogram को adjacent sides ले देखाउँछ भने तिनीहरूको resultant diagonal ले दिन्छ।

formulas.desc: Parallelogram law of vector addition (Resultant magnitude)
Direction of resultant vector R with respect to vector P

formulas.math: A · B = |A||B| cosθ = AxBx + AyBy + AzBz
formulas.desc: Scalar (Dot) Product: Zero when vectors are perpendicular
Vector (Cross) Product magnitude: Zero when vectors are parallel

pastPapers.q: State and prove the parallelogram law of vector addition.
Show that the dot product of two mutually perpendicular vectors is zero.

p11-02.title: Kinematics
p11-02.concepts: Kinematics describes motion without considering its causes. In the NEB curriculum, uniformly accelerated rectilinear motion and 2D projectile motion launched at an angle θ with the horizontal are high-weightage topics.
p11-02.bilingual: Kinematics मा हामी acceleration constant हुँदा गतिको समीकरणहरू (v = u + at, s = ut + 1/2 at²) प्रयोग गर्छौं। Projectile motion मा horizontal velocity सधैं constant रहन्छ किनभने horizontal acceleration शून्य हुन्छ।

formulas.desc: Final velocity under constant acceleration
Displacement under constant acceleration
Velocity-displacement relation
Total time of flight of a projectile
Maximum vertical height reached by projectile
Horizontal range (Maximum range occurs at θ = 45°)

pastPapers.q: Derive the expressions for maximum height, time of flight, and horizontal range of a projectile fired with velocity u at an angle θ.
Prove that the path followed by a projectile in a uniform gravitational field is parabolic.

ch11-01.title: Foundation and Stoichiometry
ch11-01.concepts: Stoichiometry is the study of quantitative relationships among reactants and products in chemical reactions. High-frequency NEB topics include the mole concept, molarity, normality, percentage composition, and limiting reactant calculations.
ch11-01.bilingual: 1 Mole भन्नाले 6.022 × 10²³ particles हुन्छ। Limiting reactant त्यो पदार्थ हो जुन रासायनिक प्रतिक्रियामा पहिले सकिन्छ र त्यसले नै बन्ने product को मात्रा निर्धारण गर्छ।

formulas.desc: Number of Moles calculation

formulas.math: Molarity (M) = Moles of Solute / Volume of Solution (L)
formulas.desc: Molar Concentration (mol/L)
Relation between Normality and Molarity
Dilution equation for molar solutions

pastPapers.q: Define limiting reagent with a suitable chemical reaction example.
An organic compound contains C = 40%, H = 6.67%, and O = 53.33%. If its vapor density is 30, find its empirical and molecular formula.

m11-07.title: Limits and Continuity
m11-07.concepts: Limits examine function behavior as variables approach a specific value. In NEB Class 11 Calculus, standard trigonometric limits, algebraic rationalization, and the definition of continuity at a point are fundamental.
m11-07.bilingual: Limit ले function को कुनै बिन्दु नजिक पुग्दाको behavior देखाउँछ। कुनै function continuous हुन Left Hand Limit = Right Hand Limit = Function value हुनुपर्छ।

formulas.desc: Standard trigonometric limit (x in radians)
Standard algebraic power limit theorem
Condition for continuity of f(x) at x = a

pastPapers.q: Test the continuity of the function f(x) at x = 2.

cs11-05.title: Fundamentals of Programming in C
cs11-05.concepts: C is a structured, procedural programming language. NEB Class 11 covers data types, operators, control flow statements (if-else, switch, loops: for, while, do-while), and 1D arrays.
cs11-05.bilingual: C Programming मा variables, loops (for, while) र conditional statements (if-else) प्रयोग गरेर problem solve गरिन्छ। NEB परीक्षामा loop tracing र short C programs धेरै सोधिन्छ।

formulas.desc: Standard for-loop syntax
Standard output function in <stdio.h>
Standard input function with address operator

pastPapers.q: Write a C program to check whether a given integer is prime or composite.
Differentiate between while loop and do-while loop with syntax.

p12-05.title: Current Electricity and Kirchhoff's Laws
p12-05.concepts: NEB Class 12 Physics focuses on Kirchhoff's Current Law (junction rule) and Kirchhoff's Voltage Law (loop rule), Wheatstone bridge principle, meter bridge, and potentiometer applications.
p12-05.bilingual: Kirchhoff's First Law (KCL) conservation of charge मा आधारित हुन्छ भने Second Law (KVL) conservation of energy मा आधारित हुन्छ। Wheatstone bridge balanced हुँदा P/Q = R/S हुन्छ।

formulas.desc: Kirchhoff's Current Law (Junction Rule - Charge Conservation)
Kirchhoff's Voltage Law (Loop Rule - Energy Conservation)
Wheatstone Bridge Balanced Condition
Comparison of EMF of two cells using a Potentiometer

pastPapers.q: State Kirchhoff's laws of electricity and use them to obtain the balanced condition for a Wheatstone bridge network.
Why is a potentiometer preferred over a voltmeter for measuring the accurate EMF of a cell?

cs12-01.title: Database Management System (DBMS & SQL)
cs12-01.concepts: Class 12 CS covers Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS), keys (Primary, Foreign, Candidate), normalization (1NF, 2NF, 3NF), and core SQL queries (DDL, DML).
cs12-01.bilingual: DBMS ले data लाई structured रूपमा store र manage गर्न मद्दत गर्छ। Primary Key ले table मा प्रत्येक row लाई uniquely identify गर्छ भने Foreign Key ले दुई table बीच relation बनाउँछ।

formulas.math: SELECT column1, column2 FROM table_name WHERE condition;
formulas.desc: Core SQL Query syntax for data retrieval
SQL Data Insertion

pastPapers.q: Define primary key and foreign key with suitable table examples.
What is normalization? Explain 1NF, 2NF, and 3NF with examples.
